title: A Deepness in the Sky
author: Vernor Vinge
summary: Two human fleets, one of traders and one of would-be conquerors, converge on a strange star that pulses on and off. They wait around a planet of spiders for the civilisation there to develop, and tensions grow.
readIf: you like big-idea science fiction with clever alien biology and layers of scheming.
skipIf: you want a quick read, since the first third builds slowly and the book is long.
